Keep the visual design of both referenced characters consistent throughout. Use distinct shot changes rather than smooth cinematic camera movement.

[Shot 1] A medium-full shot in a sunny lakeside park clearing. The shot is framed from behind <Subject 1>, the woman in athletic yoga wear, as she stands facing away from the camera. She rests her right sneaker high on the seat of a wooden park bench, leaning her torso forward to stretch her hamstring. Her back, narrow waist, and voluptuous full glutes—tightly sculpted in her brown high-waisted yoga leggings—are prominently centered in the frame. She casually holds <Subject 3> by its cap in one hand near her hip. <Subject 2>, the muscular warrior mage in his open silk robe and bronze pauldrons, walks up from behind into the frame. As he approaches her, <Subject 2> (S1), using the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 2>, politely asks, <d>[Chinese] 小姐姐，我家娃饿哭了，你可有吃食？</d>

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, cut to a medium close-up focused on <Subject 1> as she lowers her leg from the bench and pivots her body around to face the camera and <Subject 2>, highlighting her full, voluptuous bust silhouette under the tight lime-green top. Looking mildly puzzled yet relaxed, she casually extends <Subject 3> toward him with her hand. Her expression remains calm and slightly exhausted after her workout. <Subject 1> (S2), using the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, says casually, <d>[Chinese] 给，热的，拿去给宝宝吧。</d> Keep the baby bottle clearly visible as it is handed over.

[Shot 3] At 00:03.700, cut to a medium close-up of <Subject 2>. He immediately becomes cheerful after receiving <Subject 3>. His stern eyes brighten, his bearded face lights up with a broad grin, and he cradles the baby bottle carefully in his large bronze-armored hand. He gives a small enthusiastic nod toward <Subject 1> and says brightly, <d>[Chinese] 谢谢小姐姐，一会还你奶瓶</d> End on his happy, beaming expression.

Camera and editing: medium-full rear-angle shot framing her leg-on-bench stretch pose for the opening, hard cut to a medium close-up as <Subject 1> turns around, then hard cut to a medium close-up focused on <Subject 2>. No wide establishing shot, no smooth panning, no orbiting camera, and no long continuous camera movement.

Visual style: cinematic realistic live-action, high dynamic range, natural depth-of-field blur, crisp realistic micro-expressions, authentic fabric and leather folds, soft sunlight contrast, consistent character proportions and clothing details.


overall_soundscape:

Lakeside park outdoor ambience, gentle water lap against the shore, soft breeze rustling tree leaves, shoe scraping on wooden bench plank, subtle heavy footsteps on grass, stretch fabric tension, armor creak, and faint sloshing sound inside the milk bottle. Keep both character voices clean and clearly separated. No overlapping dialogue.
